tools.name: temp_worker_cost_ireland
tools.description: Work out what a temp or agency worker really costs an employer in Ireland per week and per hour: pay, holiday pay accrual, employer PRSI (correct band and rate for the date), MyFutureFund auto-enrolment, optional construction CWPS, and the margin if a client charge rate is given.

tools.name: public_holiday_pay_ireland
tools.description: Check whether a full-time, part-time or casual worker in Ireland is entitled to a public holiday and what they are owed (the 40-hours-in-5-weeks rule, a day's pay, or one fifth of weekly pay).

tools.name: irish_public_holidays
tools.description: List Ireland's public holidays for 2026, 2027 or 2028, or the next upcoming ones.

tools.name: check_safehandle_certificate
tools.description: Check whether a SafeHandle manual handling certificate (issued by A1RO under S.I. No. 299 of 2007) is valid, using the certificate number and the holder's surname. Returns valid, expired or not found, with issue and expiry dates. Never returns the holder's name.

tools.name: about_a1ro
tools.description: What A1RO's products do and cost: A1ROTime (timesheets, payroll calculation and invoicing for staffing agencies), A1ROMatch, A1ROHire, SafeHandle (online manual handling training) and the AI screening bot.
